rationale: Official Kalibrate Location Intelligence page documents geospatial data visualization, demographic/competitor reports, sales-forecast reports using models, thematic maps, loyalty/foot-traffic reports, bulk mapping/reporting, and API/data import. It does not identify AI/ML; one page does not establish comprehensive historical included functionality, so non-AI remains weak/forced. Do not conflate Kalibrate Fuel Pricing AI with this identified location-intelligence product.
version_scope: Record has no release/version. Current official Location Intelligence evidence is not dated; historical applicability is unresolved.
issues: Limited feature coverage and undated current page; no evidence whether model-based forecasts use AI.

sources.excerpt: Kalibrate Location Intelligence allows users to view, edit, and add any first party data related to your customers, locations, or competitors. Users can run demographic and competitor reports and create sales forecast reports using models that are developed and integrated for use. ... visualize thematic maps ... customer loyalty data ... mobile/foot traffic data.
sources.applicability: Official page identifies Kalibrate Location Intelligence, matching the retail real-estate/location platform in the record. It documents conventional product functions but not the source or nature of its forecasting models; no AI claim is made.
